plugin.immutable_release_snapshot_note: Published plugin Site v32/projection65 fields describe its original release snapshot. Current production deployment is recorded here; no new plugin release was created.
plugin.native_site_extension_note: Published plugin is immutable. Native Site submit adapters extend its transport and resolver; platform-specific changes are canonical under site/native, not a claim of byte parity with the immutable plugin runtime.

github.final_checkpoint_policy: This checkpoint commit is identified through Git history; its final main workflow is checked after merge and reported separately to avoid circular commit/run references.

production_promotion.behavior_change: Native ownership and persistence integration repaired; packaged stable runtime source and rule guards retained.
production_promotion.rationale: Promote the already-tested alpha.41 runtime to a stable production version while preserving all gameplay, campaign, media, mix, access and Site identity.

remaining_platform_boundary: Owner-authenticated production scene/party/art remains unverified: Google phone approval was not completed in the QA browser. Live homepage/settings and the sign-in-required boundary were observed after publication.

The native source contains 16 story nodes and 52 active choices. Only fully specified prepared transitions and supported dashboard reviews resolve automatically. Freeform requests without an exact choice match and combinations requiring unavailable rules remain queued with no gameplay changes. No complete combat or story adjudicator was invented.

390px iframe QA is not a physical iPhone test. Audio playing status was observed, but no listening-quality claim is made. Reduced-motion CSS is retained; OS emulation was not performed. Full plugin binary archive parity remains unverified.
release_policy: Stable 1.5.1 is the production plugin and canonical production source. Do not create another plugin release solely because the native Site publish action is unavailable here; publish the existing Site from its supported native surface and append that evidence to this release.
